product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.summary: The P50-2 paired two diskette drives in the Alphatronic office range.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.history: Datamation documented this factory configuration in 1985 alongside the other P50 and P60 variants.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.technical.c: The -2 variant retained access to diskettes from earlier Alphatronic systems. Datamation gives 800 KB and cites P3 and P4 compatibility. The MAME driver comment describes those drives as 720 KB DSQD.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.technical.v: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.technical.l: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
product.ta-alphatronic-p50-2.technical.s: MAME · pc.cpp · Alphatronic P50 driver notes
